Software Platform Engineer I (Onsite)

Full-time
Onsite

RTX develops aerospace and defense technologies, including radar software for military systems deployed at sea and on land. The Software Platform Engineer I will support the DevSecOps Platform Engineering Team by maintaining CI/CD pipelines, development infrastructure, security practices, automation, monitoring, and software integration activities.

Responsibilities
Assist in the design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines to facilitate efficient software development and delivery processes
Contribute to agile practices and collaborate within the team to support the delivery of high-quality products and foster continuous improvement
Support the integration of security best practices into the development lifecycle, ensuring compliance with established standards
Help maintain and upgrade the development environment infrastructure, including tools and frameworks, and provide timely support in emergent situations as needed
Work closely with software developers, program subject matter experts (SMEs), and Digital Technology (DT) and Cybersecurity teams to deliver secure and reliable software solutions
Assist in diagnosing and resolving technical issues impacting development pipelines to ensure smooth operations
Support efforts to automate repetitive tasks and explore innovative approaches to improve workflows
Help monitor pipeline performance and contribute to reporting on key metrics to ensure smooth functionality
Assist in resolving stability issues in common trunks and support the integration and testing of real-time embedded application software on Linux and Windows platforms
Contribute to maintaining and modernizing development tools, such as ClearCase, Perl, Jenkins, Smartbear Collaborator, Grafana, Coverity, and Matlab, while supporting migration to container-based environments like Git, GitLab, Podman, VSCode, and Artifactory
